senses.gloss: सदाचार सदाचार i. e. सन्त्- (ptcple. pres. of 1. अस्), m. 1. approved usage, Man. 2, 18. 2. virtuous conduct.
सदाचार + वन्त् सदाचार + वन्त्, i. e. सन्त्- (see आचार), adj. one who observes the approved usages, Man. 4, 158.
स- + आदर स- + आदर, adj., f. रा. 1. impassioned, Ṛt. 6, 14. 2. respectful, Kathās. 2, 67. Acc. sing. रम्, adv. considerately, Pañc. 33, 16; respectfully, Pañc. 71, 6.
स- + दर स- + दर, adj. fearful, afraid.
स-दृष्टि-क्षेप + म् स-दृष्टि-क्षेप + म्, adv. glancing to somebody, Śāk. 12, 7.
सदा- + गति सदा- + गति, m. 1. the sun. 2. wind. 3. the Supreme Spirit.

स- + दंशक स- + दंशक,
 I. adj. having teeth.
 II. m. a crab.
स-दक्षिण स-दक्षिण, adj. accompanied by presents, Rājat. 5, 285.
स- + दय स- + दय, adj. 1. compassionate. 2. benevolent. ˚यम्-, adv. softly, Śāk. d. 72.
स- + दर्प स- + दर्प, adj. lofty.
स- + दान स- + दान, adj. pouring out the fluid which flows from the temples of an elephant in rut, Kir. 5, 9.

सदन सद् + अन, n.
 1. A house, Pañc. ii. d. 64; a palace, Pañc. i. d. 352.
 2. Decaying, perishing.
 3. Exhaustion.
 4. Water.
 --Comp.

सादन सादन, i. e. सद्, Caus., + अन, n.
 1. Dispelling.
 2. Destroying.
 3. Wearying.
 4. Exhaustion.
 5. A house, a dwelling, Hiḍ. 4, 7.
 --Comp.

सदा- + दान सदा- + दान,
 I. n. liberality.
 II. m. 1. Indra's elephant. 2. an elephant in rut. 3. Gaṇeśa.
स-दीन + म् स-दीन + म्, adv. lamentably.
स- + देश स- + देश, adj. 1. near. 2. of the same country or place.
सद्यस्- + प्रक्षालक सद्यस्- + प्रक्षालक, m. one who cleans (corn) immediately (for use), i. e. who does not store corn, Man. 6, 18.

सद्भाव सद्भाव, i. e. सन्त्-, m. 1. the property of being, entity. 2. truth, Lass. 57, 7. 3. the property of goodness, kindness, Megh. 18, n. 4. honesty, Hit. iv. d. 103. 5. merit, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1880; a pure or holy disposition. 6. amiability.
सद्भूत सद्भ्˚, i. e. सन्त्- (ptcple. pres. of 1. अस्), adj. true.
सदा- + मद सदा- + मद, adj. ever furious, Pañc. i. d. 48 (but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1324).
सदेवासुर- + राक्षस सदेवासुर- + राक्षस, i. e. स-देव-असुर-, adj. with the gods, Asuras, and Rākṣasas, Chr. 41, 22.
सद्वचस् सद्वचस्, i. e. सन्त् (vb. 1. अस्), n. agreeable speech, Ṛt. 6, 29.
सद्विद्या सद्विद्या, i. e. सन्त्- (vb. 1. अस्), f. good learning, Bhartṛ. 2, 45.
सद्वियोग सद्वियोग, i. e. सन्त्- (vb. 1. अस्), separation from the good, Kir. 5, 51.

सद्वृत्त सद्व्˚, i. e. सन्त्- (vb. 1. अस्),
 I. adj. 1. well-behaved. 2. virtuous. 3. well-rounded.
 II. n. good or amiable disposition.
सद्वृत्तान्त सद्वृ˚, i. e. सन्त्- (vb. 1. अस्), adj. having (heard) beautiful tales, Hit. 78, 3.

शद् शद् substitutes in the pres., imperf. imperat. and potent. the pass. of शी, viz. शीय; in the remaining forms, Par. To fall, Bhaṭṭ. 17, 77 (शीय).
 --Caus.
 I. शातय (probably a denomin., perhaps from an anomal. ptcple. of the pf. pass. शात for शत्त, cf. the substitution of a vowel long by nature for one long by position, and vice versā in the Prākṛ. languages), To fell, to throw down, Rām. 1, 66, 10. शातित, Cut off, Rām. 1, 66, 12, Seramp.
 II. शादय, To drive, Pāṇ. vii. 3, 42.
 --With the prep. प्र प्र, Caus. शातय, To break off, MBh. 1, 5561.
 --With वि वि, Caus. शातय, To break to pieces, MBh. 3, 11971.
 --With सम् सम्, Caus. शातय, The same, MBh. 3, 865.
 --Cf. Lat. cadere.

1. सद् सद्, i. 1 and 6, सीद (for सिसद), Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 1, 5184),
 1. To sink down, to lie, Rām. 3, 74, 31.
 2. To sit down (ved.).
 3. To become helpless, Man. 4, 191; to be in distress, Pañc. ii. d. 24.
 4. To be impeded, Man. 9, 94.
 5. To be low-spirited, dejected, MBh. 1, 2061; Hit. iii. d. 6.
 6. To decay, to perish, Man. 4, 34; Hit. ii. d. 75.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. सन्न.
 1. Lying motionless, Man. 6, 56; still.
 2. Shrunk, diminished.
 3. Gone, lost, Kir. 3, 38.
 4. Dispirited.
 5. Oppressed, Kumāras. 7, 85.
 6. Spoiled, Ragh. 19, 19.
 --Caus. सादय,
 1. To throw down, Draup. 8, 29.
 2. To afflict, MBh. 3, 50.
 3. To destroy, Vikr. d. 42. सादित,
 1. Exterminated.
 2. Exhausted.
 3. Decayed.
 4. Broken. []
 5. Distressed, Kir. 14, 57.
 6. Drawn.
 --With the prep. अव अव,
 1. To wither, to perish gradually, MBh. 3, 2674; to perish, Daśak. in Chr. 193, 10.
 2. To be exhausted, to pine, Man. 4, 187.
 3. To be afflicted, Sāv. 5, 47. अवसन्न,
 1. Ended, Hit. 14, 6, M.M.
 2. Languid, weak, Daśak. in Chr. 194, 12.
 3. Dispirited, unhappy, Cāṇ. 65 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 411.
 4. Bent.
 5. Separated.
 6. Nonsuited.
 --Caus.
 1. To destroy, Bhag. 6, 5.
 2. To mitigate, Śāk. d. 103.
 --Comp. absol. अन्-अवसाद्य, Without desponding, Daśak. in Chr. 189, 9.
 --With व्यव वि-अव,
 1. To sink down, MBh. 3, 713.
 2. To perish, MBh. 3, 823.
 --With समव सम्-अव, समवसन्न, Sorrowful, MBh. 2, 956.
 --With आ आ, To sit down, Chr. 291, 6 = Rigv. i. 85, 6.
 --i. 1 and 10, सादय,
 1. To approach, Rām. 2, 56, 33; to come to, Pañc. 127, 17; 247, 8 (रात्रिम् आसाद्य, at night); to reach, Hit. pr. d. 47, M.M.; to overtake, Vikr. 6, 7.
 2. To attack, Rām. 1, 21, 12.
 3. To find, Man. 4, 227.
 4. To obtain, Vikr. 73, 4; MBh. 3, 10472; with गर्रम्, To become proud. Pañc. 26, 3. आसन्न, Near, Hit. 84, 7, M.M.
 --Comp.
 --Comp.
 --Absol. आसाआय,
 1. Having found. Hit. iv. d. 60 (कार्यम्, a motive. i. e. if it is one's interest).
 2. Agreeably to, Man. 8, 324.
 --With अभ्या अभि-आ,
 1. To step on, Kir. 5, 52.
 2. To obtain, MBh. 3, 17101.
 --With प्रत्या प्रति-आ, To be near, Kir. 11, 36. प्रत्यासन्न, Near, Pañc. 10, 9; imminent, Hit. 115, 15.
 --With समा सम्-आ,
 1. To approach, [] Chr. 58, 10.
 2. To encounter, to meet with, Pañc. 120, 9; MBh. 2, 553.
 3. To attach, MBh. 1, 5453.
 4. To find, Pañc. 87, 7; MBh. 1, 2346.
 5. To obtain (चेतनाम्, To recover), Pañc. 58, 19. समासादित,
 1. Attained.
 2. Obtained, Pañc. 69, 16.
 3. Finished, performed.
 --With उद् उद्,
 1. To perish, Bhag. 3, 24.
 2. † To ascend.
 --Caus.
 1. To destroy, Rām. 5, 3, 21.
 2. To draw forth, Man. 9, 267.
 --With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, Caus.
 1. To destroy, to remove, MBh. 2, 235.
 2. To draw forth, Man. 9, 261.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्, Caus. To destroy, MBh. 3, 8832.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To approach.
 2. To worship, Lass. 100, 1 = Rigv. vii. 15, 1.
 --With नि नि,
 1. To sit down, Rām. 1, 20, 14; Pañc. 8, 18 (to fall down); to plunge, Vikr. d. 41.
 2. To be afflicted, MBh. 3, 333.
 नि-षण्ण,
 1. Sitting, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 7.
 2. Placed in.
 3. Reciined, supported, Vikr. 64, 12.
 4. Gone to.
 --Caus. To cause to sit down, to kneel, Mālat. 91, 9.
 --With सनि सम्-नि,
 1. To sink down, Chr. 31, 15.
 2. To sit down, MBh. 1, 8077 (संनिषिदतुः, corr. ˚षेदतुः).
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To be propitious, gracious, Vikr. d. 39 (for the transition to this signification, cf. inclined, Lat. propensus; Germ. geneigt); to favour, MBh. 1, 1259.
 2. To be soothed, Vikr. 72, 5; Hit. ii. d. 150.
 3. To be calm, Man. 2, 54; to be glad, Mālat. 46, 12.
 4. To become clear, Man. 6, 67. प्रसन्न,
 1. Favourable, soothed, Pañc. 223, 9; kind, Vikr. d. 53; propitious, Chr. 39, 5.
 2. Quiet, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 6.
 3. Pleased.
 4. Clear, Nal. 12, 112.
 5. True, Mālat. 20, 3. f. ना, Spirituous liquor.
 --Caus.
 1. To propitiate, Vikr. d. 54; Rām. 1, 66, 24. []
 2. To soothe, Man. 11, 205.
 3. To solicit. to beg, Rām. 1, 45, 9 Gorr.; to beg pardon, Pañc. 223, 11. प्रसादित,
 1. Worshipped.
 2. Reconciled, Chr. 42, 15.
 3. Cleansed, purified.
 --With अभिप्र अभि-प्र, Caus. To soothe, MBh. 3, 14063.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, To be soothed, Rām. 2, 26, 34.
 --Caus. To propitiate, MBh. 3, 14039.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To be exhausted, MBh. 3, 448.
 2. To be afflicted. Bhag. 1, 28.
 3. To be sorrowful, MBh. 3, 3075.
 4. To despair, Hit. 82, 18. विषण्ण, Dejected, Vikr. 43, 2; sad, Rām. 1, 40, 24; desponding, spiritless.
 --Comp.
 सु-, adj. very sad, Rām. 3, 50, 28.
 --Caus. To afflict, Rām. 2, 53, 31.
 --With सम् सम्, To be in distress, Pañc. ii. d. 24; to pine, Man. 4, 33.
 --Cf. ὁδός, probably, Goth. sinths; A.S. in-sidhian, To enter (= सादय ?); οὖδος, ἔδεθλον; Lat. solum; ἕδος, ἕζομαι; Lat. sedeo; Goth. sitan; A.S. on-settan, sittan; ἵζω (= सिद् + यामि); Lat. sidere, probably de-sidero, sella (i. e. sed + la); Goth. sitls; O.H.G. sezal; A.S. sadl, sadel; O.H.G. satul; ἱδρύω.

2. ऽसद् -सद्, latter part of comp. words, Sitting, dwelling; e. g. अरण्य-, adj. Living in forests, Utt. Rāmac. 133, 6. आश्रम-, m. An anchorite, Śāk. 28, 11. गगण-, m. An inhabitant of the air, Śiś. 4, 53.
शद शद् + अ, also (but wrongly) सद सद, m. Any edible vegetable product, as fruits, Man. 8, 151; 241 (with स्).

शाद शाद, i. e. शद + अ, m.
 1. Young grass.
 2. Mud.
सद सद, see शद.
सदा स + दा, adv. Always, Pañc. i. d. 48.

साद साद, m., i. e.
 A. सद् + अ,
 1. Perishing, decay, Nalod. 2, 26; 3, 24; Vikr. d. 44 (अ-पक्ष-, Not being deprived of its wings).
 2. Weariness, exhaustion, Ragh. 8, 57; Śiś. 9, 77.
 3. Pain, Nalod. 2, 26.
 B. Purity, Padmap. 8, 20; [] cleanness.
 --Comp.

शद्रि शद् + रि,
 I. m.
 1. A cloud.
 2. An elephant.
 3. Arjuna.
 II. f. lightning.

शाद्वल शाद्वल, i. e. शाद + वल,
 I. adj.
 1. Covered with young grass, Vikr. 57, 18; Rām. 3, 50, 14.
 2. Green, Kāśīkh. 32, 50, and Aufrecht, Ujjvalad. 255, n.
 II. sbst. (n.) A place covered with grass, Kir. 7, 26.
सदा- + शिव सदा- + शिव, m. Śiva.

सदस् सद् + अस्, n.
 1. Seat, abode, Chr. 291, 2 = Rigv. i. 85, 2.
 2. (and m.), Assembly, Hit. i. d. 32, M.M.
 --Cf. ἕδος.
सदसदात्मक सदसदात्मक, i. e. सन्त् (ptcple. pres. of 1. अस्), -अ सन्त्-आत्मन् + क, adj. Being both existent and not existent, Man. 1, 11; 74.

सदस्य सदस् + य, m.
 1. An assistant at a sacrifice, Śāk. 32, 11.
 2. Any person present or belonging to an assembly, Rām. 1, 13, 23.

सदातन सदा + तन,
 I. adj. Eternal.
 II. m. Viṣṇu.

सदानन्द सदानन्द, i. e. सदा-आनन्द,
 I. adj. Always happy.
 II. m. A proper name, Vedāntas. in Chr. 219, 16.
सदृक्ष सदृक्ष, i. e. स-दृश् + स, and सदृश् स-दृश्, adj. Like, similar.

सदृश स-दृश् + अ, adj., f. शी,
 1. Like, Vikr. 36, 10; similar, Pañc. 165, 18; of the same rank, Pañc. iii. d. 219.
 2. Conformable, Śāk. 7, 4; fit, Hit. ii. d. 47; proper, right, suitable, Utt. Rāmac. 166, 6.
 3. Worthy, Utt. Rāmac. 41, 6.
 --Comp.

सद्मन् सद् + मन्, n.
 1. A house, a dwelling, Kir. 5, 30.
 2. A temple, Rājat. 5, 158 (read शूर-सद्म्˚).
 3. Water.
 --Comp.

सद्यस् सद्यस्, i. e. स-दिव् + अस् (abl.-gen. of दिव्), adv.
 1. To-day, Utt. Rāmac. 90, 7.
 2. Instantly, Pañc. 175, 1; in an instant, on a sudden, Vikr. d. 154.
सद्यस्क सद्यस् + क, adj. New, recent.
साद्यस्क साद्यस्क, i. e. सद्यस् + क, adj. Quick, instantaneous.

सद्रु सद् + रु, adj.
 1. Resting, staying.
 2. Going.
 --Cf. probably ἱδρυ in ἱδρύνω.
सद्वंद्व स-द्वंद्व, adj. Litigating, disunited, Hit. iii. d. 34.
सद्वसथ सद्वसथ, i. e. सन्त् (ptcple. pres. of 1. अस्), -वस् + अथ, m. A village.
सादि सादि, i. e. सद् + इ, m. A carioteer.

सादिन् सादिन्, i. e. सद्-इन्,
 I. adj. Destroying, Rām. 2, 34, 37.
 II. m. One who rides on a horse or elephant, or is mounted in a car, Johns. Sel. 26, 8; Rājat. 5, 451.
 --Comp.

सादृश्य सादृश्य, i. e. सदृश + य, n.
 1. Resemblance, similarity, Kir. 5, 26; Bhāṣāp. 78.
 2. A likeness, Megh. 83.
